name: Partner discount on derived maintenance (non-renewal, applied once)
what_it_tests: A partner-deal derived maintenance non-renewal line gets a SEPARATE partner-discount path that applies the discount once and avoids the standard double-discount
proc_mechanism: Partner Discount - Derived Maintenance (ItemIsDerived=true AND Deal_Type__c NotEquals 'Fortra Originated' AND ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction' AND QuoteTypeText NotEquals 'Renewal'); Stamp Partner Unit Price - Derived Maintenance; PartnerNetPricePosthook
expected_behavior: Partner discount applied once to derived net; no double discount
test_setup: Derived maintenance line, Deal_Type='Partner Originated', New quote (not renewal), not LastTransaction

prior_run.actual: Maint NetUnitPrice settled = 60.35 = 71*(1-0.15): partner discount applied ONCE (good, base 71 from license PRE-partner 355 = no double discount) BUT wrong band - used contributor/license Software 15% instead of New Maintenance 12% (expected 62.48). Also one-cycle lag: reprice#1=71 (no discount), reprice#2/#3=60.35. License net 301.75=355*0.85 correct. Header TotalPrice=362.1.
prior_run.evidence: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FdCD0A0/view (Q-00781573); maint QLI 0QLWC000003kmeE4AQ NetUnitPrice 60.35; lic QLI 0QLWC000003kmeD4AQ net 301.75
prior_run.defectStep: Partner Discount - Derived Maintenance / Stamp Partner Unit Price - Derived Maintenance (V21 steps 89-91, 108) + PartnerNetPricePosthook contributor carry-forward
prior_run.notes: SC-3346/SC-3359 lineage. Two issues: (1) wrong partner band (Software 15% carried from license contributor vs New Maintenance 12%) -> over-discounts maint 60.35 vs 62.48; (2) one-cycle stale-context lag (first reprice net=71 undiscounted). The literal 'applied once / no double discount' AC passes (base 71 = pre-partner 355*0.20, single 15% application), but resolved value is wrong.
